enGB: This weapon was once the seat of Finnean's soul. Now that the soul of the Sarkorian Pathfinder has left the weapon, it has fallen silent forever.
Aberrant bile has  worked its way into your lungs. Dealing 2 inteligence damage once per hour requires 3 successful fortitude saves to cure.
With so many separate minds sinful thought is able to split its attension between multiple tasks at once allowing it to cast all spells as though quickened.
Each brain acts as a backup for the others protecting the monster from spells that target the mind. Either that or its simply so crazed already there's no room for other effects.

Countless brains have be weaved together in this unholy abonination so much so they burst from its flesh like boils. Most of the Sinful toughts body is made up of brain tissue granting it a towering intellect but making the distiction between brain and body disapear. Sinful thoughts intelligence and wisdom are tied to its HP diminishing as it takes damage.

Almost the entirity of this creatures brain has been removed leaving it with nothing but hate and pain. This creature has no inteligence, wisdom or charisma and is immune to any effect that requires a mind. Additionally its unthinking fury grants it a +10 bonus to attack and damage rolls.
